title: Approved runtime repair: identify live failure and deployment target
instruction:
Darius approved the runtime repair plan. This individual job is READ-ONLY infrastructure diagnosis; a separate code repair is being prepared. Do NOT change code, deployments, IAM, secrets, customers, tickets, queues or job states. Do NOT rerun the failed ticket work.

GitHub WIF authenticated but its relay-invoker identity gets 403 for run.services.list/get. Use YOUR existing authorized GCP operator reads, not that identity. 2. Find the newest job matching this user error: Proactive solution plan - ALEX (failed): tickets_agent command center job failed: RuntimeError: Codex worker exited with code 1. Codex could not complete this run (exit 1) before producing a response. The runtime discarded the failed session so the next attempt can start cleanly. Read private process trace for that exact failure. Return only event time, sanitized job correlation ID, attempt, exit code, normalized cause category, configured provider/model/Codex version, duration, and whether a session/model/tool action started. Do not publish raw logs. Verify whether auth-readiness and CLI startup succeed using safe existing readiness metadata, not credential files.
3. Identify exact authorized deployment path and rollback target for a tested worker source fix. Do NOT deploy.

STOP after these reads. Report actual evidence or the exact unavailable permission/tool; do not narrate a discovery plan. Results go to GitHub: INFRASTRUCTURE METADATA ONLY. No secret/env values, auth.json contents, access tokens, raw prompts/stderr, customer names/IDs/emails, Salesforce content, SQL rows or billing records. Keep all sensitive evidence private and return a private handle only when necessary. Do not claim a check or success without readback.
